hooks.name: Sync Status Docs on Save
hooks.description: After any .py or .html file is saved, silently update PROJECT_STATUS.md and .kiro/steering/onboarding.md with the current timestamp and a brief note about what changed. Also append one line to .kiro/CHANGELOG.md.

action.prompt:
A file was just saved in the RoadIQ project (${file}). Do the following silently without interrupting the user:

1. In PROJECT_STATUS.md, update the '**Last updated:**' line to today's date/time ET and a short description of what file changed (e.g. '2026-08-05 14:32 ET — saved server.py').

2. Do the same update in .kiro/steering/onboarding.md.

3. Prepend one line to .kiro/CHANGELOG.md in this format:
   - YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM — saved <relative_file_path>
   Create .kiro/CHANGELOG.md if it doesn't exist, with header:
   # RoadIQ Auto-Changelog
   _Auto-updated on every .py/.html save. Newest first._

   Keep only the 100 most recent entries.

Do NOT modify any other files. Do NOT add commentary to PROJECT_STATUS.md or onboarding.md beyond updating the timestamp line. Do NOT interrupt the user or ask questions.
